column2: How do I record the performances of a play, the evening’s roles and the understudies?
column3: An evening of the “🎭 Theatre” kind: the “Production” field makes it one of its performances (the production’s record lists them all, with “＋ Add a performance”); “Evening’s roles”: the role, played by 👤, regular, standing in, understudy, created the role; also incidents, curtain calls and box office takings. The actor’s filmography counts their performances and stand-ins.

column2: How do I turn a concert recording into “live” recordings?
column3: On the evening’s record, 🎙 Recordings box: choose the sound or video, then “→ Turn into “live” recordings”. Each track in the setlist that has a record gets a “Live” recording (date, place, recording, timing noted on the line); “↶ Undo” right after if needed.

column2: How do I make the filmography and stage credits of an actor or actress?
column3: Catalogue → 🎭 Roles tab. Each detailed role is a record: the work (film, series, episode, production…), the character, the kind of role (lead, supporting, extra, voice, dubbing…), the director 👤, the credits, the shoot (period, locations), the co-stars, the fee, the contract, performances and stand-ins, the original voice, the anecdote. The list also gathers the films in the catalogue, the series (episodes ticked), the evening roles of performances and records from other catalogues that mention the person. Tabs Cinema, Television, Theatre, Voice, Advertising…, search, filters (kind of role, years, director, co-star), sorting, List | Cards | Timeline; a click on a line shows its card; “＋ Make it a detailed role record” for a line coming from elsewhere.

column2: Where can I see all the people who have profiles (artist, athlete, elected official…)?
column3: Lists → “This person was… (profiles)”: one row (or one card, “Cards”) per person with the coloured badges of their profiles. Filter ▾ by profile, group, number of profiles, occupation, customised page or locked record; Sort ▾ (A → Z, most profiles, most records…). A click opens their page. The “Occupations” list stays separate: it sorts the occupations (a text), this one the people.

column2: How do I make a section of a person’s page ¾ or ⅔ wide, or change the colour of its edge?
column3: On their page: “⚙️ Organise the page”. Each section has its width (full line, ½, ⅓, ¼, ⅔, ¾) and a colour badge for the top edge (app colours, recent colours, eyedropper, # code, “None” = no edge; ↺ = the profile’s colour). In “All together”, a profile’s badge changes its colour (badges, edges, timeline). The same goes for the artist’s page.

column2: How do I set the pages of all the people who have profiles in one go?
column3: Settings → Appearance → Person and animal records → “This person was… (profiles)”. On the left the standard setting (order, visibility, width and colour of the sections; order, colour and visibility of the profiles; templates), on the right an exception for one person (chosen in the picker). At the bottom, the customised pages: “↗ Open” or “↺ Reset to default” (the page goes back to the standard setting, with ↶ Undo). “💾 Saved settings” keeps everything under a name.

column2: Why can I no longer edit a person’s catalogue or page?
column3: Their record is locked (or the app is in view-only mode): the catalogue, its work records and their profile page open read-only (“🔒 Locked record” at the top); the buttons to edit, add a profile or a record are hidden. Unlock the person’s record to edit.

column2: Why “Tick Craftsperson?” when I add a piece of ironwork or ceramics?
column3: A craft piece (ironwork, ceramics, glass, goldsmithing, cabinet-making, instrument-making…) goes into the “Craftsperson” profile (or “Artist” if it is already ticked). A work of art (sculpture, painting…) asks for “Artist”; a tour or a series, “Artist” or “Actor”.

column2: How do I show the “Actor” profile on a person’s page?
column3: Tick the “Actor, actress, performer” profile (🎭 Roles tab → “🎬 Tick the profile”, or the record’s profiles). Their page gains its sections: roles (with Cinema, Television, Theatre…), filmography, television, stage credits, voice, advertising, music videos, statistics (roles per decade, most frequent directors and co-stars, lead / supporting), training, agents and companies, castings, awards, skills and voice, stage evenings. “⚙️ Organise the page” arranges them, hides them, chooses their width; “…” on a section writes the profile.

column2: How do I record a series, its seasons and its episodes (IMDb-style)?
column3: Catalogue → “＋” → 🎬 Films and shows → Series and programmes → “＋ New series, programme”. On its record: “＋ Add a season”, then “＋ Several…” creates all the numbered episodes at once (you then write their title, date, director, screenplay, guests, filming locations, music, video). Click a season to see its episodes, an episode for its card. Same model for a television or radio programme, a podcast, a radio serial, a manga in volumes or a book saga (cycle → volumes).

column2: How do I record the episodes in which a person acted or worked?
column3: On the series’ record, the “👤 … in this series” panel: 🎭 Role (character, kind of role) or 🛠 Job (screenwriter, director, composer…). Tick the episodes in the list (Shift+click for a whole range), or write “episodes 2 to 7” → Tick, or “the whole season”, “the whole series”; add the credited name and the fee, then 💾 Save. Their filmography then shows “recurring · S3 ep. 2-7 (6 episodes)”. “＋ A person…” for another crew member; “Remove” offers “↶ Undo”.

column2: I deleted a record or a work by mistake: how do I get it back?
column3: Right after, “↶ Undo” in the message at the bottom left: the record comes back, with the same number and all its links. To keep a catalogue elsewhere: ⤓ Export → 💾 File, then ⤒ Import → “A file exported from here” (the old “JSON backup” can be re-imported too).

column2: How do I record an invention and its patents?
column3: On the inventor’s record: open their page (catalogue) → 💡 Inventions → “＋ New invention”. Field, problem, principle, first idea, workshop; “📜 Patents”: one line per country (country, no., filing, grant, applicant, status) and, with 📝, the title, the claims, the class, the patent attorney; then prototypes, licences, manufactured objects, prior art and lawsuits, awards (Lépine competition…).

column2: How do I record a discovery (species, comet, gene, site…)?
column3: The person’s page → 🔬 Discoveries → “＋ New discovery”: choose the “Kind” (species, comet, gene, fossil, archaeological site, wreck…) and the matching fields appear. Then the place (on the map), the discoverers 👤, the naming (name, in honour of, status), the publications and “recognised or disputed”.

column2: How do I make a scientist’s profile (thesis, positions, students, publications)?
column3: Tick “🔬 Scientist” on their record, then open their page: each section (thesis, laboratories and positions, publications, academic genealogy, missions, academies, things named after them, notebooks…) has its “…” button to write in. Institutions are Employer records. ⚙️ Organise the page → “Template: Scientist” for the starting order.

column2: How do I import a researcher’s publications (DOI, ORCID, HAL)?
column3: The scientist’s page → 📚 Publications → “⤒ Import (DOI, ORCID, HAL)”: paste DOIs, their ORCID identifier or their name in HAL, tick what to take. Those already there are recognised (same DOI or same title); their name among the authors is linked to their record.

column2: How do I see the academic genealogy (supervisor, students)?
column3: The “🌳 Academic genealogy” section of the scientist’s page: their thesis supervisor and their mentors above, their students below. If a student has their own record with this thesis supervisor, they are added automatically.

column2: How do I record an expedition and draw its route on the map?
column3: Tick “🧭 Explorer” on their record, then page → 🧭 Expeditions → “＋ New expedition”: “🗺 Route”, one line per stage (place, dates, means, ▲ summit): the map draws itself. Then members 👤 and their roles, firsts, notebooks and films, collections and where they are today, accounts, place names.

column2: How do I note that a person appeared in the newspaper, on the radio or on TV?
column3: On their record, the “📰 In the media” block → “＋ Add”: the kind of media (press, radio, TV, podcast, web, newsreels, book, poster), the type of appearance (interview, portrait, report, obituary, birth or marriage notice, review, published photo, small ad…), the date, the outlet (chosen in “Lists → Magazines and periodicals”, or written as it is), the title or programme, the page or duration, the journalist, the other people with their role (★ main, ☆ secondary), the subject, the tone, an extract, and the scan, sound or video (the images, sounds and videos window). The block shows a timeline by year and “📰 Press · 📻 Radio · 📺 TV” badges to sort what you see.

column2: Where can I see all the family’s articles and programmes?
column3: Lists → “Press review”: all the appearances of all the people, with the usual bar (🔍 Search, Filter ▾ by person, kind of media, type, tone, List | Cards, Sort). From a record, “See all” opens the same list already filtered on the person (“Joseph MARTIN ×” badge: one click removes it to see everyone). ⚙️ chooses the columns, “⤓ Export” gives a spreadsheet, a PDF or a file.

column2: How do I record a prize, a medal, a decoration or a competition (even an unusual one)?
column3: On the record, the “🏆 Competitions and awards” block → “＋ Add”: the category (sport, game, food, unusual, agricultural, artistic, school, professional, decoration… or your own word), the award, the competition (a 🏅 record that gathers its whole list of winners: “＋ Create” directly from the field), the edition, the level (local → world), the event, the date, the place, the performance, the rank, the medal, the title won, the prize, the organiser, the jury or teammates, the trophy or the cutting. For a decoration (Légion d’honneur, Mérite agricole, medals…) the grade, the promotion, the decree, the file (Léonore database) and the sponsor also appear. Lists → “Honours list” gathers the whole family, with its timeline.

column2: How do I record school, diplomas and classmates?
column3: On the record, the “🎓 Diplomas and education” block: “＋ A stage” for each school or training (primary school, secondary school, high school, university, apprenticeship, compagnonnage, military training…) with the establishment (a record that gathers everyone who went there), the years, the class, boarder or day pupil, the teachers and classmates (picker with a role), the subjects, the results, the end-of-year prizes, the class photos and the school reports; “＋ Add” in “Diplomas” for a diploma (ready-made list: certificat d’études, brevet, CAP, baccalauréat, degree, driving licence, military certificates… or free text). The block shows the timeline of the path, the table of diplomas, the latest class photo with the classmates, and the school record books and reports.
